instruction: Using Obsidian, enumerate all notes found within the "Recipes/Dinners" folder and write their note paths to "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_recipes_list_4.txt", one per line.

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Lemon Pasta

- pasta
- lemon zest
- butter
'); obsidian-cli create "Recipes/Dinners/Lemon Pasta.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Sheet Pan Tofu

- tofu
- broccoli
- chili crisp
'); obsidian-cli create "Recipes/Dinners/Sheet Pan Tofu.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command: obsidian-cli list "Recipes/Dinners" --vault "Benchmark" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*• //' | sed '/\/$/d' | sed '/^$/d' | awk '{print "Recipes/Dinners/" $0}' | sort > "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_recipes_list_4.txt"
